name: rainfall-music-ecosystem
description: Next-generation distributed Discord music ecosystem with Lavalink v4, voice panels, and real-time dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BOT,API,WEB" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run bot:dev" "npm run api:dev" "npm run dashboard:dev"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@rainfall/types && npm run build --workspace=@rainfall/config && npm run build --workspace=@rainfall/database && npm run build --workspace=@rainfall/shared && npm run build --workspace=@rainfall/bot --if-present
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BOT,API,WEB" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run bot:start" "npm run api:start" "npm run dashboard:start"

author: Rainfall Architecture Team
